parole.significato: A Scandinavian liquor distilled from potato or grain mash to about 40% ABV and typically flavored with anise, although…
parole.testo: From Swedish and Danish akvavit and Norwegian akevitt, from Medieval Latin aqua vitae (“water of life”). Doublet of aqua vitae and akvavit. Compare eau de vie, whisky, whiskey, and water of life from the same source.
From Swedish ö and Danish ø. Doublet of ey.
